item.title: Iran War Live Updates: As Talks to End War Resume in Qatar, U.S. Conducts Strikes on Iran’s Gulf Coast
item.description: Iranian officials went to Doha on Monday for the negotiations, hours before the U.S. military announced the strikes it said were in “self defense” to protect troops. Israel’s leader said his country plans to intensify attacks against Hezbollah, Iran’s ally, in Lebanon.

item.title: Middle East live: US carries out 'self-defence' strikes on Iran
item.description: US forces have struck missile sites and boats allegedly laying naval mines in southern Iran on Monday, according to United States Central Command. The move threatens to further destabilise a fragile ceasefire as Iranian negotiators arrived in Doha for high-stakes talks aimed at ending the war. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Possible Iran-US deal: What we know about the key issues on both sides
item.description: The United States and Iran have downplayed prospects for a rapid deal to end the Middle East war, despite signs of progress in talks. Key sticking points remain over Iran’s nuclear programme, control of the Strait of Hormuz, sanctions relief and a possible ceasefire in Lebanon, with both sides signalling that major issues are still unresolved.

item.title: Middle East live: Iran's president issues order to restore global internet access
item.description: Iran's ⁠President Masoud ​Pezeshkian has issued ​an order to reopen international internet access, Iranian ​state ‌media ⁠reported on Monday, ‌citing an official. Authorities first imposed an internet blackout from January 8 in response to nationwide anti-government protests, with ​access gradually returning to normal in ​February, before a new blackout ​following the start of US-Israeli strikes against Iran on ​February 28. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Israel pounds Lebanon with fresh air strikes, vows to 'crush' Hezbollah
item.description: Israel intensified air strikes across southern and eastern Lebanon on Monday after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu vowed to “crush” Hezbollah, deepening fears of a wider regional conflict. The escalation comes despite an April ceasefire and as another round of US-Iran talks takes place in Doha in a bid to negotiate terms for a broader Middle East peace deal.

item.title: As new Iran deal faces sharp criticism, Trump seeks to widen Abraham Accords
item.description: GOP lawmakers warned against concessions to Iran in any deal to end the war, while doubts greeted Trump’s push to expand pacts between Israel and Muslim-majority nations.

item.title: Iran signals ‘mass sacrifice’ in 'high stakes' Saddam-era warning amid Trump deal talks
item.description: Expert says Iran's Pezeshkian mapped a foundational wartime symbol onto current U.S. and Israel tensions, signaling Tehran won't back down easily.

item.title: U.S. military strikes Iran as Trump says negotiations move forward for deal to end war
item.description: The U.S. military announced strikes against Iranian positions just hours after President Trump says more countries should normalize ties with Israel in any Iran deal, tempering expectations of peace.

item.title: 'My body carried me,' Elizabeth Smart says. Now she's celebrating it
item.description: Her abduction at age 14 drew international attention. After her rescue, Smart says she struggled with feeling shame around her body. Bodybuilding has helped her see herself differently.
